page.overview:
What is Mundungus?

Mundungus "Dung" Fletcher was a half-blood wizard who was involved in many illegal activities, having a notoriously disreputable reputation as a petty criminal. Many members of the Order had mixed feelings about him, but he was very loyal to the Order's head, Albus Dumbledore, who once got Fletcher out of serious trouble.

Very little is known of Mundungus's early life, although it is known that he was born in Great Britain or Ireland to the Fletcher family sometime before 1962.

When he was eleven years old, he received a wand and went on to attend Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry for seven years. At some point during his time at Hogwarts, his parents died, which left him feeling lonely for the rest of his life. By 1 September of 1997, all of Mundungus's family had died, and he never married or had any children.

Sometime around 1970, Mundungus joined the newly-founded Order of the Phoenix.
